messages.source: 需要 Node.js 22 或更新版本。从仓库根目录启动；网站脚本无需安装第三方 npm 依赖。
messages.text: Use Node.js 22 or later from the repository root. The website scripts do not require third-party npm dependencies.

messages.text: Open http://127.0.0.1:4173/ in your browser. Development is at /notes/ and the lab is at /notes/lab/. Use the local HTTP server rather than opening index.html directly.

messages.source: 端口占用时运行 npm run dev -- --port 4174。Windows 也可使用根目录的 start-dev.cmd。
messages.text: If the port is busy, run npm run dev -- --port 4174. On Windows, you can also use start-dev.cmd in the repository root.

messages.source: 修改文案与栏目内容，阅读“内容编辑”；添加作品，阅读“接入新项目”；准备上线，阅读“构建与发布”。
messages.text: Read Editing content for text and section changes, Add a project for new work, and Build and publish when preparing a release.

messages.source: 找到正确的数据源，避免在多个页面重复维护同一段说明。
messages.text: Edit the authoritative data instead of repeating the same description across pages.

messages.source: 作品名称、简介和视频地址维护在 content/site-data.js。保留视频状态区的生成标记，由 npm run video:sync 同步关联入口。不要在各个 HTML 中逐一修改同一个 BV 号。
messages.text: Titles, summaries, and video URLs live in content/site-data.js. Keep the generated video-block markers; npm run video:sync updates related links. Do not edit the same BV identifier in multiple HTML files.

messages.source: 开发项目登记在 content/development/catalog.json；各项目说明维护在 content/development/projects/。先编辑来源，再生成 notes 页面。Markdown 阅读资料由 config/documents.json 登记。
messages.text: Register development projects in content/development/catalog.json and edit their descriptions in content/development/projects/. Edit the source, then regenerate notes pages. Register Markdown reading resources in config/documents.json.

messages.source: 实验数据位于 content/experiments/，原始作品位于 experiments/。记录完整提示词、模型名称、已知设置和原始产物；没有记录的设置标注为“未记录”，作品展示与评测结论分开说明。
messages.text: Experiment records live in content/experiments/ and original artifacts in experiments/. Keep the complete prompt, model, known settings, and original file. Use Not recorded for unknown settings and distinguish examples from benchmark conclusions.

messages.source: 生成命令同步开发页、目录和可按需读取的正文。随后生成网站其他页面。
messages.text: The build updates development pages, directories, and separately loaded article bodies, followed by the other website pages.

messages.source: 了解页面、内容与脚本的职责，按模块查找源码。
messages.text: Understand the responsibilities of pages, content, and scripts and find the relevant source.

messages.source: index.html、projects/、games/、tools/、about/ 和 notes/ 提供可直接访问的页面。assets/ 维护共享样式、交互与站内导航。原有页面地址保留。
messages.text: index.html, projects/, games/, tools/, about/, and notes/ provide directly accessible pages. assets/ contains shared styles, interactions, and internal navigation. Existing page URLs are preserved.

messages.source: content/ 保存作品、项目与状态数据；config/ 保存资料登记和发布配置。notes/ 与搜索索引主要由脚本生成，不作为文案的首选编辑位置。
messages.text: content/ stores works, projects, and status data; config/ contains document registrations and publication settings. notes/ and the search index are primarily generated and are not the preferred place to edit copy.

messages.source: 目录与摘要在构建时合并；文章正文在打开文章时读取。导航意图预加载尊重节省流量设置，动画不会随目录页面自动启动。
messages.text: Directories and summaries are compiled together; article bodies load when an article is opened. Navigation preloading respects data-saving preferences. Animations do not start with directory pages.

messages.source: packages/ 保存游戏和工具的独立工程；games/ 保存对应介绍与试玩入口。各工程的素材、依赖和运行方式以自身说明为准。
messages.text: packages/ contains independent game and tool projects; games/ contains their introductions and playable entries. Each project documents its own assets, dependencies, and startup process.

messages.source: 登记一个作品，复用现有项目页面与导航。
messages.text: Register a work and reuse the existing project pages and navigation.

messages.source: 项目 ID 使用简短的英文小写和连字符。命令创建草稿，不会立即出现在公开目录中。
messages.text: Use a short lowercase ID with hyphens. The command creates a draft that does not immediately appear in the public directory.

messages.source: 填写简介、可用链接、当前阶段、资料和参与方式。一个项目使用独立状态文件；不要复用其他项目的任务来源。
messages.text: Provide a summary, working links, current stage, resources, and contribution information. Each project needs its own state file; do not reuse another project's task source.

messages.source: 资料齐全后将 visibility 设为 public，运行生成与检查命令。停止更新的项目可设为 archived，保留原链接和历史记录。
messages.text: When the resources are ready, set visibility to public and run the build and checks. Use archived for inactive projects to preserve their URLs and history.

messages.source: 生成页面、核对改动，再通过 GitHub 发布。
messages.text: Generate pages, review the changes, and publish through GitHub.

messages.source: 先生成页面，再执行仓库已有检查。任何失败都应在提交前解决。
messages.text: Generate the pages, then run the existing repository checks. Resolve every failure before committing.

messages.source: npm run release:prepare 生成 .local/publish，npm run release:check 核对发布产物。源码仓库与网站产物是不同目录；是否使用产物部署取决于仓库的 Pages 配置。
messages.text: npm run release:prepare creates .local/publish and npm run release:check verifies the artifact. Source and website output are different directories; deployment depends on the repository's Pages configuration.

messages.source: 查看 Git 差异，确认只包含本次修改。使用普通提交和推送；如远端有新提交，应先重新对齐，不要强制覆盖。
messages.text: Review the Git diff and include only the intended changes. Use a normal commit and push. If the remote has new commits, realign first instead of force-pushing.

messages.source: 部署工作流成功后，在浏览器确认主要入口、前进后退和移动端布局。自动检查不等于真实设备体验。
messages.text: After deployment succeeds, check the main entry points, browser history, and mobile layout. Automated checks do not replace real-device verification.

messages.source: 统一标题、状态与资料分工，让访客知道可以做什么。
messages.text: Use consistent titles, statuses, and documentation roles so visitors know what they can do.

messages.source: 标题说明页面内容；简介说明可做的事。按钮使用“打开作品”“阅读指南”“下载源码”等明确动作，避免交付口吻和空泛评价。
messages.text: Titles describe the page; summaries explain what visitors can do. Use clear action labels such as Open work, Read guide, and Download source. Avoid delivery notes and unsupported praise.

messages.source: 已可访问的内容与计划中的功能分开写。开发候选不能写成正式版本；没有数据支持时不标注完成率、性能提升或模型评分。
messages.text: Distinguish available content from planned features. A development candidate is not a release. Do not claim completion percentages, performance gains, or model scores without supporting data.

messages.source: README 提供总览与启动入口；项目概览解释用途；资料页提供操作步骤；更新页记录变化。维护日志和历史报告留在 docs/，不重复铺到访客页面。
messages.text: README provides the overview and setup links; project overviews explain the purpose; guides provide instructions; updates record changes. Keep maintenance logs and historical reports in docs/ rather than duplicating them on visitor pages.

messages.source: 保留署名、许可、素材来源和历史链接。实验展示说明提示词、模型与已知设置，不将推测写成记录。
messages.text: Preserve credits, licenses, asset sources, and historical URLs. Experiment records state the prompt, model, and known settings, not guesses.

messages.source: 小Q的作品展示网站。这里集中说明网站结构、内容编辑、项目接入与发布方式。
messages.text: Aha_xiaoQ's portfolio website. Find its architecture, content-editing workflow, project registration, and publication guides here.

messages.source: 游戏和工具在各自栏目体验；网站实现与维护资料在这里阅读。从本地启动开始，再按需要查找内容编辑或发布说明。
messages.text: Try games and tools in their own sections. Read about the website's implementation and maintenance here, starting with local setup and then content editing or publication.

messages.source: 访客入口与开发资料分开组织，先找到内容，再深入实现。
messages.text: Visitor entry points and development resources are organized separately, from discovery to implementation.

messages.source: 各项目共用导航与视觉规范，保留独立的内容、源码与更新记录。
messages.text: Projects share navigation and visual rules while retaining their own content, source, and update records.

messages.source: 实验室记录提示词、模型信息与可直接运行的作品。
messages.text: The lab keeps prompts, model information, and runnable original artifacts.

腿部根据脚踏位置计算膝关节，踩踏、车轮与前进节奏共同变化。
messages.text: Knee positions follow the pedals while pedaling, wheels, and forward motion change together.

messages.source: 海岸风景分层移动，眨眼、围巾与花篮为骑行增加细小动作。
messages.text: Layered coastal scenery, blinking, a scarf, and a flower basket add small details to the ride.

messages.source: 三档速度、暂停与继续、空格键控制，支持减少动态效果的系统偏好。
messages.text: Three speeds, pause and resume, keyboard control, and support for the system's reduced-motion preference.

messages.source: 这里提供最初生成的 HTML，展示页不重新绘制或替换动画。单个示例不等于通用性能评测。
messages.text: This is the originally generated HTML. The showcase does not redraw or replace the animation. A single example is not a general performance benchmark.

messages.source: 提示词约束：不做测试。推理强度设置未记录，也没有统一评测数据。
messages.text: Original prompt constraint: no testing. The reasoning-effort setting was not recorded, and no standardized benchmark data is available.

messages.source: 从提示词到可运行作品。保留原始输入、模型信息和实际效果，让结果自己说话。

messages.source: 这里收录小型交互与代码创作实验。每个实验提供提示词、已知设置和原始产物；观察具体表现，不给单次结果编造综合评分。
messages.text: Small interaction and coding experiments, each with its prompt, known settings, and original artifact. Observe concrete results without inventing an overall score.

messages.source: 作品可在线体验，也可下载独立文件。
messages.text: Try the work online or download the standalone file.

messages.source: 模型设置按实际记录展示，未知项不推断。
messages.text: Settings follow the actual record; unknown values remain unknown.

messages.source: 欢迎提出新的实验题目，或反馈作品在不同设备上的实际表现。
messages.text: Suggest new experiment prompts or report how a work behaves on different devices.

messages.text: Characters from different games relay through classic levels. See each level's roster, playable entries, and development plans.

messages.source: 第一至第四期已开放独立试玩：魂斗罗与洛克人、忍者与坦克、泰拉瑞亚，以及索尼克与奥日城堡关。地图工坊支持从 32 关参考底图创建地图、试玩和离线导出。M07 开发候选与已上线试玩分开维护。
messages.text: Episodes 1–4 have independent playable releases: Contra and Mega Man, Ninja Gaiden and Battle City, Terraria, and the Sonic/Ori castle. Map Workshop supports creating, trying, and exporting maps from 32 reference templates. The M07 development candidate is maintained separately from the released games.

messages.source: 1-1 至 1-4 四期独立试玩已上线；第四期为索尼克与奥日。
messages.text: Four independent releases cover 1-1 through 1-4. Episode 4 features Sonic and Ori.

messages.source: 地图工坊提供 32 关参考底图与地图编辑、试玩、离线导出；不等同于八世界成品。
messages.text: Map Workshop offers 32 reference maps, editing, playtesting, and offline export; this is not a finished eight-world crossover.

messages.text: Contribute device checks, clearer instructions, or focused code improvements. Read the tasks and confirm the scope in an issue first.

messages.source: 需要 Node.js 22 或以上，无需 npm install。解压源码，在工程根目录执行：
messages.text: Use Node.js 22 or later. No npm install is required. Extract the source and run these commands from the project root:

messages.source: 启动后访问 http://127.0.0.1:4193/play.html。角色选择中标明关卡；操作、按键和游戏设置从顶部进入。
messages.text: After starting, open http://127.0.0.1:4193/play.html. The character selector identifies each level. Access controls, key bindings, and settings from the top bar.

messages.source: 界面升级包含清晰 HUD、窄屏快捷栏、角色操作说明及最近提示。重新开始和切换角色会先确认。
messages.text: The interface includes a clearer HUD, narrow-screen quick actions, character-specific controls, and recent notices. Restarting or changing characters asks for confirmation.

messages.source: 当前 HTML 入口为 src/app/player.template.html。文案、界面交互和 HUD 各有独立模块，见 UI_CONTRACT.md。修改 src 后重启服务并刷新，不编辑 dist。
messages.text: The HTML entry is src/app/player.template.html. Copy, interface behavior, and the HUD have separate modules described in UI_CONTRACT.md. Restart the server and refresh after editing src; do not edit dist.

messages.source: 从项目任务页选择改进，按 CONTRIBUTING.md 运行检查。地图、战斗与素材沿用第三期底稿，本版没有新增正式关卡。
messages.text: Choose an improvement from the project tasks and follow CONTRIBUTING.md for checks. Maps, combat, and assets retain the Episode 3 baseline; this candidate adds no released levels.

messages.source: 0.4.3 尚待 Windows、实体设备、音频、自然通关与真实浏览器网络验收。
messages.text: Version 0.4.3 still needs Windows, physical-device, audio, complete-playthrough, and real-browser network verification.

messages.source: WorldKit W02 继续使用其固定 M06 运行时；32 关模板与本 UI 候选分别维护。完整泰拉角色、武器和坐骑仍不能直接用于任意地图，独立第四期（1-4）已上线，通用运行时角色迁移仍待验收。
messages.text: WorldKit W02 retains its fixed M06 runtime. Its 32 templates and this UI candidate are maintained separately. Full Terraria characters, weapons, and mounts cannot yet be used on arbitrary maps. The independent fourth episode (1-4) is live; character migration to the general runtime remains under review.

messages.source: 旧源码和过程记录保留在历史资料。
messages.text: Older source versions and development notes remain in the historical resources.

messages.source: 索尼克 × 奥日 · R43 高潮循环版。独立源码工程、构建方法与原版对照校验。
messages.text: Sonic × Ori · R43 climax-loop edition. Independent source project, build instructions, and byte-for-byte comparison.

messages.source: 本工程整理自已发布的第四期 R43（索尼克 × 奥日，1-4）。保留原有游戏内容、地图、声音与素材声明；它不是第三期 M07 源码的替代品，也不代表通用运行时角色迁移完成。
messages.text: This project organizes the released Episode 4 R43 (Sonic × Ori, 1-4). It preserves the gameplay, maps, audio, and asset notices. It neither replaces the Episode 3 M07 source nor completes character migration to the general runtime.

messages.source: 未改动源码时，可以重新构建出与 R43 发布 HTML 逐字节一致的单文件游戏。第四期在线试玩继续保留，不会被源码构建自动覆盖。
messages.text: Without source changes, the build reproduces the R43 single-file HTML byte for byte. The released online game remains separate and is never overwritten automatically by the source build.

messages.source: 解压源码，在工程根目录使用 Node.js 22 或以上版本运行。无需 npm install。
messages.text: Extract the source and use Node.js 22 or later from the project root. No npm install is required.

messages.source: 启动后访问 http://127.0.0.1:4194/play.html。Windows 也可双击源码包内的 start-dev.cmd；端口被占用可改为 npm run dev -- --port 4195。
messages.text: Open http://127.0.0.1:4194/play.html after starting. Windows users can run start-dev.cmd from the source package. If the port is busy, use npm run dev -- --port 4195.

messages.source: src/app 为页面壳，src/styles 为 6 组样式，src/runtime 为 26 个按顺序编译的逻辑片段；src/data 保留音频及拾取配置。assets/audio 与 assets/images 收录从现有发布 HTML 提取的 260 个去重素材。
messages.text: src/app contains the page shell, src/styles contains six style groups, and src/runtime contains 26 logic fragments compiled in order. src/data retains audio and pickup configuration. assets/audio and assets/images contain 260 deduplicated assets extracted from the release HTML.

messages.source: 源码片段仍共享原版作用域，不是可任意逐个 import 的独立模块。编辑后运行 npm run build，产物为 dist/play.html；完整导航见源码包 START_HERE.md 和 docs/MODULE_MAP.md。
messages.text: The fragments share the original scope; they are not independent modules that can be imported in arbitrary order. Run npm run build after editing to produce dist/play.html. See START_HERE.md and docs/MODULE_MAP.md in the source package for navigation.

messages.source: 上升段保留原 R43 的 Restoring the Light, Facing the Dark 48 秒高潮循环音轨，使用原生音乐通道。不替换原有地图、角色动作、BGM 或音效。
messages.text: The ascent retains R43's 48-second climax loop from Restoring the Light, Facing the Dark through the native music channel. Maps, character motion, music, and sound effects are not replaced.

messages.source: 源码构建校验不代替真实设备、手柄、音频或自然通关验收。第三方角色、图像与录音的权利归各权利人；本次整理不扩大原有授权。部分历史资源仍保留外部回退地址。
messages.text: Build verification does not replace device, controller, audio, or complete-playthrough testing. Third-party characters, images, and recordings belong to their rights holders; reorganizing the source does not expand any license. Some historical assets retain external fallback URLs.

messages.source: 选择任务、修改源码、提交测试与 PR。
messages.text: Choose a task, edit the source, and submit tests with a pull request.

messages.source: 在源码根目录运行 npm run tasks，或从项目任务页选择一项改进。在 Issue 中说明方案并确认范围后创建功能分支。设备复验、按键标签、文档说明都可以单独提交。
messages.text: Run npm run tasks in the source root or choose an improvement from the project task page. Discuss the approach and scope in an issue before creating a feature branch. Device checks, key labels, and documentation can be separate contributions.

messages.source: 修改 src/ 或 content/，不要编辑 dist/。提交源码和对应测试，写清实际行为差异、候选校验值和未验证设备，不把全仓格式化或其他玩法一起提交。
messages.text: Edit src/ or content/, not dist/. Include source and relevant tests, explain the behavioral difference and candidate checksum, and identify unverified devices. Avoid bundling repository-wide formatting or unrelated gameplay changes.

messages.source: 通过测试才进入人工审阅。设备、自然通关、音频和素材许可需单独核验；代码合并不是发布批准。保留原 NOTICE，不添加未经核验的新素材。
messages.text: Passing tests leads to human review, not automatic release. Devices, complete playthroughs, audio, and asset licenses need separate checks. Preserve NOTICE and do not add unverified assets.

messages.source: 编辑地图、试玩马里奥，保存工程并下载离线版本；也可获取开发模板。
messages.text: Edit maps, playtest Mario, save projects, and download offline games or development templates.

messages.source: 从工具页进入地图工坊，选择“从底图创建”，按世界与关卡加载副本；也可以新建空白地图。原始参考地图保持不变。
messages.text: Open Map Workshop from Tools and choose Create from reference to load a copy by world and level, or start with a blank map. Original reference maps remain unchanged.

messages.source: 支持地形、平台、管道、敌人和奖励编辑；保存 .qmap.json 工程可继续制作。试玩使用马里奥运行器，支持键盘、触屏与外接手柄。
messages.text: Edit terrain, platforms, pipes, enemies, and rewards. Save a .qmap.json project to continue working later. The Mario playtest runner supports keyboards, touchscreens, and external controllers.

messages.source: 可下载当前地图的独立 HTML，也可下载按关卡顺序推进的连续版并自由选关。离线初始生命默认 3 条，可设为 1–30 条；开发者试玩可开启附近安全位置复活。
messages.text: Download a standalone HTML for the current map or a campaign version with level progression and level selection. Offline games start with three lives by default, configurable from 1 to 30. Developer playtesting can enable revival at a nearby safe location.

messages.source: 全屏、音乐与音效、制作信息和像素字体包含在试玩中。离线 HTML 用于游玩，继续编辑请另存工程文件。
messages.text: Playtests include fullscreen, music and sound settings, credits, and a pixel font. Offline HTML is for playing; save the project file separately for further editing.

messages.source: 32 关共 63 个参考区域，另保留循环城堡的分段视图。马里奥试玩已接入奖励、弹簧、平台、游泳、管道、藤蔓和城堡结算等机制；这些功能仍需逐关核验，不代表原版逐帧一致。
messages.text: The 32 maps contain 63 reference areas, plus separate views of looping castle sections. The Mario runner implements rewards, springs, platforms, swimming, pipes, vines, and castle completion. Each level still needs review; this is not a claim of frame-accurate equivalence.

messages.source: M06 开发模板使用独立通用运行器，不等同于地图工坊试玩；独立第四期已上线；真实混合角色向通用模板迁移仍在开发。魂斗罗 1-2 试验版暂不发布。
messages.text: M06 development templates use a separate general runtime and are not the Map Workshop runner. The independent fourth episode is live. Migration of crossover characters to general templates remains in development; the Contra 1-2 experiment is not publicly released.

messages.source: 第四期独立试玩与视频入口。已上线游戏和开发候选分别维护。
messages.text: Independent Episode 4 game and video links. Released games and development candidates remain separate.

messages.source: 索尼克与奥日加入马里奥 1-4。第四期保留独立游戏实现，已上线不表示 M07 开发框架完成全部角色迁移。
messages.text: Sonic and Ori enter Mario 1-4. Episode 4 retains its independent implementation; its release does not mean that all characters have been migrated to the M07 framework.

messages.source: 本次仅维护网站介绍、视频入口和文档状态，不改变地图、角色动作、BGM 或音效。
messages.text: This record maintains the website introduction, video links, and documentation status without altering maps, character motion, music, or sound effects.

messages.source: 第四期 · 索尼克 × 奥日：视频入口已更新，请从下方链接观看。
messages.text: Episode 4 · Sonic × Ori: use the link below to watch the video.

messages.source: 马里奥地图工坊：视频入口已更新，请从下方链接观看。
messages.text: Mario Map Workshop: use the link below to watch the video.

messages.source: 混合马里奥Ⅲ · 泰拉瑞亚
混合马里奥Ⅳ · 索尼克 × 奥日
混合马里奥 III · 泰拉瑞亚
第三期 · 泰拉瑞亚旅途的开始，把泰拉瑞亚带进马里奥 1-3，挑战地表、地底、坐骑与武器，面对克苏鲁之眼和独眼巨鹿。
messages.text: Episode 3 · Terraria enters Mario 1-3. Explore above and below ground, try mounts and weapons, and face the Eye of Cthulhu and Deerclops.

messages.source: 游戏、工具和制作记录。选择项目查看源码与进展。
messages.text: Games, tools, and making-of notes. Choose a project to explore its source and progress.

messages.source: 选择一项任务，查看验收要求后到仓库讨论。待验收表示仍需核对，不等于已发布。
messages.text: Choose a task, read its acceptance criteria, and discuss it in the repository. Awaiting review does not mean released.

messages.source: 不必先掌握整个项目。先选择感兴趣的作品，把一次体验、一个问题或一条清楚的建议带回来。
messages.text: You do not need to understand the whole project first. Pick a work that interests you and share an experience, an issue, or a clear suggestion.

messages.source: 下载源码，运行项目，再选择一个明确的改动。
messages.text: Download the source, run the project, and choose a focused change.

messages.source: 还没有公开的更新记录。计划确认后会在这里说明。
messages.text: No public updates yet. Confirmed plans will appear here.
This record is not public yet.

messages.source: 已发布的试玩在独立页面运行；操作方式、声音设置和素材说明见游戏内菜单。
messages.text: The released game runs on its own page. See the in-game menus for controls, audio settings, and asset notices.

messages.source: 语言与字体由共享模块处理；新增内容先登记译文，再生成页面并检查缺字与回退。
messages.text: Shared modules handle language and typography. Register translations for new content, then build and check glyph coverage and fallbacks.

messages.source: 日常修改统一运行 npm run platform:verify。它依次生成内容与页面，汇总源代码检查和测试，再核对发布产物；任何失败都不会被当成发布通过。
messages.text: Run npm run platform:verify for routine changes. It generates content and pages, collects source checks and tests, and then verifies the publication artifact. A failed step is never treated as release approval.

messages.source: 新实验登记在 content/experiments/catalog.json。复制一份记录，填写原始提示词、模型和产物校验值；页面、目录与下载入口由同一登记生成。
messages.text: Register new experiments in content/experiments/catalog.json. Create a record with the original prompt, model, and artifact checksum. That registration generates its page, directory entry, and download links.

messages.source: 更新包由明确的基线和文件差异生成。只携带本次修改，检查文件冲突、原始作品校验值和发布结果，不覆盖其他人的新提交。
messages.text: Update packages are generated from an explicit baseline and file differences. They carry only the intended changes, check conflicts and original artifacts, and never overwrite someone else's new commits.

messages.source: 运行、构建、校验和打包的入口由 config/site-platform.json 统一登记。旧命令继续有效；模块职责和生成文件归属见源码中的 docs/platform/。
messages.text: config/site-platform.json registers the common build, verification, and packaging workflow. Existing commands remain available. See docs/platform/ in the source for module responsibilities and generated-file ownership.
This document is available in Chinese.

messages.source: 部分历史记录保留中文原文。
messages.text: Some historical records retain their original Chinese text.

messages.source: 历史实验，保留原始记录。
messages.text: Archived experiment. The original record is preserved.

messages.source: 在作品中操作；需要时可在新窗口打开。
messages.text: Interact with the work, or open it in a new tab.

messages.source: 未提供英文版本的内容保留中文原文。
messages.text: Content without an English version is shown in its original Chinese.

messages.source: 链接可能已更改，或地址输入有误。作品和开发资料仍可从下面找到。
messages.text: The link may have changed, or the address may be incorrect. You can still find projects and development resources below.
Leave a note before you go.

messages.source: 想聊作品、分享点子，或只是说声你好，都欢迎。
messages.text: You are welcome to discuss a project, share an idea, or just say hello.
Pick a game. Start an adventure.
Try it out. See how it works.

messages.source: 建议使用桌面浏览器；可用键鼠或手柄游玩。
messages.text: A desktop browser is recommended. Play with a keyboard and mouse or a gamepad.

messages.source: 在浏览器中打开，按游戏内提示开始。
messages.text: Open in your browser and follow the in-game instructions.

messages.source: 预览图暂时无法显示，仍可开始试玩。
messages.text: The preview image is unavailable. You can still start the game.

messages.source: 这里打开已发布的试玩页。开发源码与实验功能在“开发”栏目中单独说明。
messages.text: This opens the released game. Development source and experimental features are documented separately in Dev.

messages.source: 按键说明、声音和暂停选项请查看游戏内菜单。浏览器未播放声音时，先与游戏页面交互，再检查音量；也可以先静音体验。
messages.text: See the in-game menu for controls, sound, and pause options. If there is no audio, interact with the game first, then check the volume. You can also play muted.

messages.source: 下载后解压，再打开其中的 index.html。浏览器游戏与可下载文件的可用内容，以该版本说明为准。
messages.text: Extract the download, then open index.html. Refer to the version notes for the content available in the browser and downloadable editions.

messages.source: 浏览器游戏与可下载文件的可用内容，以该版本说明为准。
messages.text: Refer to the version notes for the content available in the browser and downloadable editions.

messages.source: 体验作品、查看源码，遇到问题也有去处。
messages.text: Try the projects, explore the source, and find help when needed.

messages.source: 第一次来，从游戏列表选择一款作品，点击“开始试玩”即可。想看制作过程，再进入开发资料。
messages.text: Start by choosing a game and selecting Play now. Visit the development resources to learn how it was made.

messages.source: 查看游戏封面和简介，选择一款开始。操作方式和支持的设备以游戏内说明为准。
messages.text: Browse the covers and descriptions, then choose a game. Check the in-game instructions for controls and supported devices.

messages.source: 开发栏目提供源码、运行方法和可参与的任务。待验收的开发版与已发布的试玩版分开标注。
messages.text: Dev contains source code, setup instructions, and tasks to contribute to. Development candidates awaiting review are labeled separately from released games.

messages.source: 先点击游戏的开始或声音按钮，再检查浏览器标签页和系统音量。音频仍未就绪时，可以先静音试玩；具体加载与重试方式见游戏内设置。
messages.text: Select the game's start or sound button, then check the browser tab and system volume. You can play muted while audio loads. See the in-game settings for loading and retry options.

messages.source: 先让游戏获得焦点，再按当前显示的按键操作。手柄、触屏和改键支持因作品而异；手机上的操作支持请看各作品说明；没有触屏按钮时，请在电脑上体验。
messages.text: Focus the game, then use the controls shown. Gamepad, touch, and remapping support vary by project. Check each project's mobile guidance; use a computer when touch controls are not provided.
A page or asset did not load

messages.source: 检查网络后重试。返回作品介绍页可以确认版本和下载入口。不要为恢复加载而先删除存档或重置全部浏览器数据。
messages.text: Check your connection and retry. The project page lists its version and downloads. Do not delete saves or reset all browser data as a first troubleshooting step.

messages.source: 记录作品名称、版本、浏览器、输入设备与复现步骤。在相应项目的任务或参与页面提交反馈；避免附带密码、个人存档等敏感信息。
messages.text: Include the project, version, browser, input device, and steps to reproduce the issue. Use the project's Tasks or Contribute page. Do not include passwords, personal saves, or other sensitive information.
Choose a project to report an issue

messages.source: 第三期开发源码（独立维护）
开发源码 0.4.3。下载、运行与参与开发。
messages.text: Development source 0.4.3. Download, run, and contribute.

messages.source: 这是 0.4.3 开发候选，和已发布试玩分别维护；完整设备与自然通关验收尚未完成。
messages.text: This is the 0.4.3 development candidate, maintained separately from the released game. Full device testing and natural playthrough review are not complete.

messages.source: 地图工具 W02 使用独立的 M06 运行时，完整角色尚不能直接用于任意地图。第四期试玩与源码另有入口。
messages.text: Map tools W02 use a separate M06 runtime. Full characters cannot yet be used directly on arbitrary maps. Episode 4 has separate game and source entries.

messages.source: 源码包保留贡献指南、模块说明、测试和版本记录。
messages.text: The source package includes contribution guidance, module documentation, tests, and version history.
Development documentation for a historical version.

messages.source: 本文对应标题中标注的版本；当前源码和适用范围请查看项目资料。
messages.text: This document applies to the version in its title. See the project resources for current source code and scope.

messages.source: 保留原源码快照与阶段记录，用于版本比对。
messages.text: Source snapshots and milestone records retained for version comparison.

messages.source: 本文保留当时的版本与结论。请从项目资料页获取当前源码。
messages.text: This document preserves the version and findings recorded at the time. Get current source code from the project resources.

messages.source: 地图坐标、分段与核验约定
messages.text: Map coordinates, sections, and review conventions

messages.source: 已发布的关卡可以直接体验；开发中的内容持续更新。
messages.text: Play released stages now. Work on upcoming content continues.

messages.source: 不同武器与射击方式，闯过熟悉的地上关卡。
messages.text: Use different weapons and firing styles to cross the familiar overworld stage.

messages.source: 忍者龙剑传 / 坦克大战
32 张底图，下一关由你来定义。
messages.text: 32 base maps. Shape the next stage.

messages.source: 每关提供地形、对象定位、区域关系与开发清单。先选地图，再设计合适的角色能力。
messages.text: Each stage includes terrain, object positions, area connections, and a development checklist. Choose a map, then design suitable character abilities.

messages.source: 63 个参考区域 · 33 个循环路线分段。模板已整理不代表 32 关游戏已完成；水下与循环机关仍需驱动，模板采用社区参考，不是官方导出；原版独立核验与自然通关仍待完成。
messages.text: 63 reference areas · 33 loop-route sections. Organized templates do not mean all 32 stages are finished games. Underwater and looping mechanics still need drivers. Templates use community references, not official exports; independent fidelity review and natural playthroughs are still pending.

messages.source: 开发资料重新分类，加入实验室
messages.text: Reorganized development resources and added the lab

messages.source: 按入门、内容维护、发布与参考组织网站资料；减少开发页首次切换的加载依赖。实验室收录鹈鹕骑行动画、原始提示词与模型信息。
messages.text: Website resources are organized into getting started, content maintenance, publishing, and references, with fewer loading dependencies on the first Dev visit. The lab includes the cycling pelican, its original prompt, and model information.

messages.source: 欢迎反馈链接、阅读和移动端体验问题。较大的结构或视觉调整，请先在 Issue 中说明目标与方案。
messages.text: Reports about links, readability, and the mobile experience are welcome. Discuss the goals and approach in an issue before major structural or visual changes.

messages.source: 浏览项目进展、阅读开发资料，或在实验室查看提示词与实际作品。
messages.text: Browse project progress, read development resources, or compare prompts and actual results in the lab.

messages.source: 第四期索尼克与奥日独立试玩已上线
messages.text: Episode 4: Sonic and Ori is available as a standalone game

messages.source: 补齐第四期介绍、试玩和关卡进度入口。四期独立游戏与 M07 待验收开发候选分别维护，视频状态见当前视频入口。
messages.text: Added Episode 4 introduction, game, and stage-progress entries. The four standalone games are maintained separately from the M07 development candidate awaiting review. See the current video entries for video status.

messages.source: 第四期 R43 最终源码独立整理
为已发布的索尼克与奥日第四期增加独立源码目录、源码下载与启动说明。样式、运行时代码和内嵌素材分离维护，可无损还原 R43 发布 HTML；原有四期试玩、第三期 M07 与视频链接保持独立。
messages.text: Added a separate source directory, download, and setup guide for the released Sonic and Ori episode. Styles, runtime code, and embedded assets are maintained separately and rebuild the exact R43 release HTML. The four games, Episode 3 M07, and video links remain independent.

messages.source: 地图工坊测试版源码已合入主分支
messages.text: Map Workshop beta source merged into main

messages.source: 支持从 32 关参考底图创建、编辑与保存工程，马里奥试玩、外接手柄和单关/连续版离线导出。相关实现已合入主分支；隐藏路线与复杂机关继续核验。魂斗罗角色迁移暂不开放。
messages.text: Create, edit, and save projects from 32 reference maps, playtest with Mario and a gamepad, and export offline single-stage or campaign games. The implementation is in main; hidden routes and complex mechanics remain under review. Contra character migration is not yet open.

messages.source: 开发栏目支持多个项目
各项目分别提供概览、任务、资料与更新入口。
messages.text: Each project has its own overview, tasks, resources, and updates.

messages.text: Visit two projects and their subpages from Home, then test forward, back, and reload.

messages.source: 减少动态效果设置生效
日常预览使用 npm run dev；修改后用 npm run platform:build 重新生成页面；提交前运行 npm run platform:verify。内容编辑、接入项目和发布细节分别见对应指南。
messages.text: Use npm run dev for local preview, npm run platform:build to regenerate pages after edits, and npm run platform:verify before submitting changes. Separate guides cover content editing, project registration, and publishing.

messages.source: 在 content/experiments/catalog.json 登记实验；记录文件放在 content/experiments/，原始作品放在 experiments/。保留完整提示词、模型与已记录的设置，没有记录的推理强度使用 null。目录、详情和下载入口由登记生成，不另改路由。
messages.text: Register experiments in content/experiments/catalog.json, keep their records in content/experiments/, and store original works in experiments/. Preserve the full prompt, model, and recorded settings; use null for unrecorded reasoning effort. Registration generates the directory, details, and download links without separate route edits.

messages.source: 先修改内容来源，再重新生成页面供本地预览；不要直接编辑 notes/ 中的生成页面。准备提交时，再运行完整检查，确认直达页面、导航和发布产物一致。
messages.text: Edit the content source first, then regenerate pages for local preview; do not edit generated pages in notes/ directly. Before submitting, run full verification to check direct entries, navigation, and the publication artifact together.

messages.source: 站内导航由一个路由模块负责，搜索与资料模块只管理自身内容和资源。异步结果只更新当前页面；离开页面后，旧事件和回调不得改写地址、抢走焦点或重新挂载内容。
messages.text: One router owns site navigation; search and guide modules manage only their own content and resources. Asynchronous results update only the active page. Events and callbacks from a previous page must not change the URL, steal focus, or remount content.

messages.source: 内容齐全后将 visibility 设为 public，运行完整检查并审阅生成结果，再提交发布。停止更新的项目可设为 archived，保留原地址；草稿、待验收与已发布状态应按实际情况填写。
messages.text: Once the content is ready, set visibility to public, run full verification, review the generated result, and then submit it for publication. Projects no longer maintained can be archived while retaining their URLs. Draft, awaiting-review, and released states must reflect the actual project status.

messages.source: npm run platform:plan 只查看流程；npm run platform:verify 执行生成、源码测试、发布产物与浏览器检查。检查失败时先阅读失败摘要和对应日志，修复后重新验证，不跳过失败步骤。
messages.text: npm run platform:plan only displays the workflow. npm run platform:verify generates pages and runs source, publication-artifact, and browser checks. On failure, read the summary and relevant log, fix the cause, and verify again without skipping failed steps.

messages.source: 完整检查已包含 release:prepare 和 release:check，日常不必重复运行。它们分别生成和核对 .local/publish；单项诊断时才独立执行。源码提交成功与 Pages 部署完成是两个结果，上线后仍需检查实际网址。
messages.text: Full verification already includes release:prepare and release:check; there is no need to rerun them routinely. They generate and validate .local/publish and can be run separately for diagnosis. A successful source push and a completed Pages deployment are different results; check the actual site after deployment.

messages.source: 在完整仓库验证通过后，用明确的提交基线生成增量包。验证后再次修改文件，需要重新验证。接收端在独立工作区检查，遇到文件冲突或远端新提交会停止；游戏、字体和已有源码档案继续使用各自发布流程。
messages.text: After verification passes in the complete repository, generate an incremental package against an explicit commit baseline. Verify again after any further edit. The receiving workspace stops on file conflicts or new remote commits; games, fonts, and existing source archives keep their separate publication workflows.

messages.source: 中文 README 的网站页面入口使用 lang=zh，英文 README 使用 lang=en。网页按钮和提示补齐对应译文；原始提示词、代码、许可及未翻译文章保留原文，不把中文隐藏来冒充翻译完成。
messages.text: Website page links in the Chinese README use lang=zh; those in the English README use lang=en. Provide translations for interface controls and messages. Preserve original prompts, code, licenses, and untranslated articles rather than hiding Chinese text to imply complete translation.
